title: K3 Knowledge Ascension-Assimilation Standard Operating Procedure v2.0
content: Four-phase SOP for systematic K3 knowledge recycling: Phase 1 Deep Anatomy (1.1 identify old paradigm core, 1.2 extract valid engineering heritage, 1.3 diagnose paradigm blind spots, 1.4 NEW theoretical isomorphism scan against MSS theory library). Phase 2 Paradigm Decoupling (2.1 strip old paradigm core, 2.2 identify logic viruses, 2.3 discard/retain decision). Phase 3 Meaning Re-anchoring (3.1 axiom anchoring, 3.2 terminology ascension, 3.3 theory reconstruction). Phase 4 Engineering Application (4.1 MSS-exclusive predictions, 4.2 verification experiments, 4.3 engineering tools, 4.4 NEW vacuum transition plan - how to use existing K3 experimental frameworks).
